gen-dafont-oldtimer-fs-public-sans: Oldtimer brings round, parenthesis-like forms and a commanding, classic voice with no calligraphic swell. Public Sans takes the quieter job, a hefty lowercase with broad open counters that carries the words.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-general-sans: General Sans moves with steady pressure and an x-height that fills the line, set under the rounded, commanding display forms of Oldtimer. Smooth curves throughout.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-gf-bhutuka-expanded-: Round forms like open parentheses, with no calligraphic swell, announce Oldtimer. BhuTuka Expanded One answers in a curvy text serif that feels unclamped, slowing your reading to a leisurely, literary walk.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-gf-hepta-slab: Rounded and stately, a classic look takes over the top, where Oldtimer curves like open parentheses without any calligraphic swell. Hepta Slab stretches each word out below.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-gf-kiwi-maru: Kiwi Maru spaces its letters generously and rings each o with a constant wall, sitting beneath the round, commanding forms of Oldtimer. Paragraphs unspool slowly, like a traditional editorial page.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-gf-padyakke-expanded: Oldtimer draws round forms like open parentheses, classic and commanding, with no calligraphic swell on any downstroke. Padyakke Expanded One spreads wide below it, so give the body a little extra room.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-gf-stint-ultra-expan: Round forms like open parentheses, with no swell on any downstroke, give Oldtimer its commanding, classic stance. Stint Ultra Expanded then lets each character float apart, a traditional serif with counters leading outward.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-satoshi: Classic and commanding, Oldtimer rounds its forms like open parentheses, while Satoshi lifts a soaring x-height and a wide-open e beneath it. Each keeps to its own job.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-switzer: Approachable Switzer is wiry and tubular, with a tall waist line and c tips that never close in. Oldtimer is best at round, commanding display forms, while Switzer carries the text.
gen-dafont-origami-bitter: Origami sets a sign-painter's single-stroke brush look at constant width, its lowercase heavy as poured lead type. Bitter is built for the running text, a dependable slab-serif with a very large lowercase eye and a visible gap in each s.
